title: Pull
author: Keane M.
desc: Unleash your upper body strength with the Pull program, designed for those looking to enhance their back and arm muscles in just one week. This focused routine features a variety of effective exercises, including Lat Pulldowns, T-Bar Rows, and Bicep Curls, ensuring a comprehensive workout that targets your lats, upper back, and biceps. With dedicated sessions structured for optimal intensity and recovery, you’ll build muscle and improve your lifting performance. Get ready to pull your way to a stronger you!

ex.note: Use vertical grip pull down towards your pocket for lats
